mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_reminder( user_id, tool_name, params, reminder_hour, reminder_minute, enabled, status, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{toolName}, #{params}, #{hour}, #{minute}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tool_name, params, reminder_hour AS hour, reminder_minute AS minute, enabled, status, last_triggered_date, attempt_count, next_retry_at, locked_until, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM health_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = TRUE AND status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY reminder_hour, reminder_minute, id

SELECT id, user_id, tool_name, params, reminder_hour AS hour, reminder_minute AS minute, enabled, status, last_triggered_date, attempt_count, next_retry_at, locked_until, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM health_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE AND status != 'CANCELLED' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE health_reminder SET enabled = FALSE, status = 'CANCELLED', locked_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE AND status != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tool_name, params, reminder_hour AS hour, reminder_minute AS minute, enabled, status, last_triggered_date, attempt_count, next_retry_at, locked_until, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM health_reminder WHERE enabled = TRUE AND (last_triggered_date IS NULL OR last_triggered_date < #{today}) AND ( (status = 'ACTIVE' AND reminder_hour = #{hour} AND reminder_minute = #{minute}) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE health_reminder SET status = 'RUNNING', locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE AND (last_triggered_date IS NULL OR last_triggered_date < #{today}) AND ( (status = 'ACTIVE' AND reminder_hour = #{hour} AND reminder_minute = #{minute}) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE health_reminder SET status = 'ACTIVE', last_triggered_date = #{triggeredDate}, attempt_count = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE health_reminder SET status = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'FAILED' END, enabled = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
